spec.name: swing_profile
spec.function_code:
def swing_profile(close, high, low, vol, L=12, atr_k=0.25, dth=15.0):
    """Swing Profile [BigBeluga] (TV Editors' Pick, script gFlv7t7R) -> -1/0/+1 vote.

    Per-SWING volume profile. Detects confirmed fractal pivots (a bar is a swing
    high/low if it is the extreme of L bars EACH SIDE), takes the LAST CONFIRMED
    swing (the leg between the two most recent opposite pivots), bins its volume
    into ATR-sized price buckets, finds the POC (highest-volume bucket) and the
    leg Delta% (buy vs sell pressure). Buy/sell split uses close-vs-prior-close
    as the candle-direction proxy because the chart_read dispatcher does NOT pass
    `open` (signature is vote(name, high, low, close, vol)) and MT5 only gives
    tick_volume, not true bid/ask traded volume.

    CAUSAL / NON-REPAINTING: pivots require L right-side bars to confirm, so we
    only ever read a swing that is already LOCKED. We never touch the current
    forming swing's live POC -- that is the classic BigBeluga repaint trap that
    makes charts look perfect and live fail.

    Vote = mean-reversion-to-POC + delta-exhaustion confirm:
      price below locked POC AND sellers exhausted the down-leg (D < -dth) -> +1
      price above locked POC AND buyers exhausted the up-leg   (D > +dth) -> -1
      else 0.
    """
    n = len(close)
    if n < 4 * L + 20:
        return 0
    # 1) confirmed fractal pivots (symmetric L-bar window; never reads future of 'now')
    piv = []  # (idx, 'H'/'L')
    for p in range(L, n - L):
        wh = high[p - L:p + L + 1]; wl = low[p - L:p + L + 1]
        if high[p] == max(wh) and high[p] != min(wh):
            piv.append((p, 'H'))
        elif low[p] == min(wl) and low[p] != max(wl):
            piv.append((p, 'L'))
    if len(piv) < 2:
        return 0
    # 2) last CONFIRMED swing = between the two most recent OPPOSITE-type pivots
    (i2, t2) = piv[-1]; (i1, t1) = piv[-2]
    if t1 == t2:
        return 0
    a, b = (i1, i2) if i1 < i2 else (i2, i1)
    if b - a < 3:
        return 0
    sc = close[a:b + 1]; sh = high[a:b + 1]; sl = low[a:b + 1]; sv = vol[a:b + 1]
    # ATR-sized bins (adaptive resolution across volatility regimes)
    trs = [max(sh[k] - sl[k], abs(sh[k] - sc[k - 1]), abs(sl[k] - sc[k - 1]))
           for k in range(1, len(sc))]
    atr = (sum(trs) / len(trs)) if trs else (max(sh) - min(sl)) / max(1, len(sc))
    bin_w = max(atr * atr_k, 1e-9)
    lo = min(sl); buckets = {}
    for k in range(len(sc)):
        j = int((sc[k] - lo) / bin_w)
        buckets[j] = buckets.get(j, 0.0) + sv[k]
    if not buckets:
        return 0
    poc_idx = max(buckets, key=buckets.get)
    poc = lo + (poc_idx + 0.5) * bin_w
    # 3) leg delta from candle direction (close vs prior close = bull/bear proxy)
    B = sum(sv[k] for k in range(1, len(sc)) if sc[k] > sc[k - 1])
    S = sum(sv[k] for k in range(1, len(sc)) if sc[k] < sc[k - 1])
    if B + S <= 0:
        return 0
    D = 100.0 * (B - S) / (B + S)
    price = close[-1]
    if price < poc and D < -dth:
        return 1
    if price > poc and D > dth:
        return -1
    return 0

spec.repaint_check:
PASS -- causal, no lookahead, non-repainting BY CONSTRUCTION.

- Pivots need L bars of RIGHT-SIDE confirmation, so the function only reads a swing
  whose extreme is already locked. It NEVER reads the live/forming swing's POC --
  that is the exact BigBeluga repaint trap (mid-swing POC != post-swing POC) that
  report #4 flagged. The price/POC comparison uses price=close[-1] against a POC
  computed only from bars [a..b] where b is a CONFIRMED pivot at least L bars in the
  past, so b < n-1 strictly. No bar after the decision point is touched.
- Inherent L-bar lag is acceptable and identical to chart_read's other structure
  voters (supertrend/keltner/sr_zone) -- lag is not lookahead.
- Honest test gate (do NOT skip): run
  C:\Users\Radhi\MT5\r_native_v2\indicator_accuracy.py per symbol. It is OOS,
  no-lookahead by design: it lets each voter vote using only data up to bar i, then
  scores sign(close[i+8]-close[i]); writes hit_rate, lift, votes to
  r_native_v2\data\indicator_accuracy_<SYMBOL>.json -- the same file _learned_factors
  reads. CAVEAT to verify in that lab: confirm the function is fed a growing prefix
  (data[:i+1]) per step, never the full series, so the pivot scan cannot see future
  bars relative to bar i. The function is written for that (it scans its own input
  range only), so it is honest as long as the harness slices correctly.
- Two unavoidable approximations, documented not hidden: (a) MT5 tick_volume is
  tick-COUNT, not true traded volume, so the profile is approximate; (b) buy/sell
  split uses close-vs-prior-close (dispatcher passes no `open`), a direction proxy,
  not real bid/ask delta.
spec.verdict:
ON TRIAL -- expect LOW-to-NONE real directional edge; let the 0.2 floor bury it if it is noise. Do NOT promote on "charts look good."

WHICH INDICATOR: the four reports name three different tools (Liquidity Thermal Map,
Swing Profile x2, Deviation Trend Profile). Two of four -- including the single most
rigorous report -- converge on SWING PROFILE (TV script gFlv7t7R) as the Editors'-Pick
winner, and it plugs in identically to our existing on-trial cisd/choch/ifvg. I built
Swing Profile. (If later evidence says the video's pick was Deviation Trend Profile, that
one is a trivially-causal SMA-slope/ATR-band trend voter -- a clean separate add; and
Liquidity Thermal Map is the same volume-profile family as this, largely redundant.)

WHY LOW EDGE (honest, matches our prior SMC-video result where CISD/CHoCH ~50% = hindsight):
  1. The tool REPAINTS by design; the honest causal version (locked-swing only) throws
     away exactly the part that makes it look magic on a chart.
  2. MT5 tick_volume is tick-count, not true volume -> the profile/POC is approximate.
  3. The buy/sell delta is a candle-direction PROXY (no bid/ask), so "order flow" is soft.
  4. POC/value-area is a real microstructure concept but it is a CONTEXT tool BigBeluga
     themselves do not sell as a signal.
  5. FRIDAY ALREADY has 6+ volume/profile-adjacent voters (vwap, obv, mfi, chaikin,
     sr_zone, liq_sweep) -> marginal new information is small.

KEEP-RULE (decide on measured numbers, not vibes): run indicator_accuracy.py on
XAUUSDm / BTCUSDm / EURUSDm across M5/M15/H1. KEEP only if hit_rate >= 0.53 with >= 40
votes on >= 2 symbols; otherwise the learned-weight pipeline floors it to 0.2 and it
harmlessly fades. Net cost of adding it = ~60 lines + O(window) compute; net risk =
near-zero because the measured-accuracy weighting is self-correcting. Ship on trial.
